_about: Registry of this style's components (SYSTEM.md): what each one is, its kind and the regexes (sig) that find it in a built index.html. scripts/components.py plan / check / add / record read and write it: history lists your reels in order, projects maps a reel id to its project folder, and each element's reels say where it was used. Empty history = nothing used yet.
_about_components: kind = hook / scene / prop / frame / transition / outro (new every reel) or emphasis / signature / house (may stay); sig = regexes (a LIST) on the built index.html; history = reels in order; projects = where each reel's index.html is. scripts/components.py reads and writes this file.

elements.desc: every spoken word on its onset on a layer between the speaker's plate and its matte (the head hides the lower part), the baseline on the crown of the head + the tier offset; wide / tight switch times kept
size by importance: Inter Tight 600 tiers T / M / B (never under 56 px), the voice or payoff word of a clause in Playfair Display Italic (about 1 in 6)
the first word of a face world fades in over 6 frames (0 .11 .51 .80 .91 .96 1) and rises 30 px (E6)
E5 navy word card (#0B1829, warm #FAE9D4 words): a question, doubt or turn line; the phrase appends in place or drops a second line
E20 white word page (#F1F1F1, #0F1827 words): statements between face worlds, the stressed word flickers on

E21 step card: full-screen field rotating navy / off-white / electric blue, the giant Playfair italic numeral (960 px) entering at x1.48 with a 4-frame blur and shrinking circ.out, a 10-frame glow stepping down hard, the words pushed back on top
E22 captions over a full-screen clip tinted to its light (cream #FAFCD4 on the bench) with a glow of the same hue, pushed back x1.47 on entry
E8 flicker-on: the stressed word appears with 6 stepped opacity keys (dark: 1 .32 .60 .34 .74 1, light pages: .84 .14 .32 .14 .46 1)
X8 the reel's one punch-in: the same take x1.20, hard, plate and matte together, on the clause the speaker leans on
E10 / E25 an electric-blue box (#2534E9) grows centre-out under a word, starting 5 frames before it (power1.inOut 0.3 s); the word on it in white serif italic
frame 0 = the speaker's face (tight, eyes to lens) with the first word big behind the head, the caption layer pushed back x1.36 -> 1 (circ.out 0.6 s) and drifting (E2 curve)

hook 2: B&W paper prints of the line's objects (laptop, letters, headset, calendar, clock, desk) swapped on a ~10 fps clock with jitter and a squash glitch, the spoken words one at a time in red Inter Tight 700, the layer pushed back on each clause (E1 + E2; the reference: eye macros)

hook 3: the quiet cream card after the loud ones: a black disk with a crescent moon that wanders on twos and is swallowed on the line's last word, tiny words hugging the disk left / right (E4; the reference: an eye in the disk)
the promise as a title card: small Playfair caps building word by word, the big caps word on its word, the block shrinking circ.out, an RGB split from three channel copies (E3)
the metaphor clip in a white paper panel on navy (E18), a tiny line above building word by word, the Playfair label (what the clip shows) on its word, fade-up from dark
the same clip continues full screen after its panel (media-start carries on) under scene-tinted captions: the carpenter's hand on the finished board
sig: <video id="\w+_full" class="full" src="assets/ins/[^"]+" data-start="[\d.]+" data-duration="[\d.]+" data-media-start="[1-9]

elements.desc: step 1's picture: five drawn unfinished tables pop in on the number word, a white lift + 1-frame jump onto the middle one on the next stressed word with the others racked soft, its missing leg draws on the line's last words (E24 + X5)
step 2's picture is a callback: the tables return with the centre one finished, the others soft, the noun on a blue box (self-reference R9)
a counter: on the number word the numeral counts 1 -> 10 one value per frame, the rest of the line lands under it (E15)
X3 a white page brightens to white and blurs over its last 7 frames into the next card
X7 a card fades up from dark: 35 % on its first frame, 100 % on the next
X1 the diagram blurs 1 / 2 / 4 / 7 / 11 / 16 px over its last 6 frames, hard cut to Step 2 (a whoosh-cine starts with the blur)
X4 Step 3's numeral and words leave left (power2.in 0.75 s, the blur growing), hard cut, the face's caption layer comes in from the right (circ.out 1.24 s)

flat outro: the payoff word as the reel's one gradient word (Montserrat 800, orange -> magenta -> blue) behind the head, flicker-on + 100 px rise, the clause steps aside; no CTA, ends on the last word (the reference: the 'preset' CTA keyword)
frame 0: an electric-blue bar above the head with the speaker's own hook line in white Playfair italic (two lines), held across the first two worlds (0-2 s) while the live words land behind the head
hook 2: a B&W generated still of the line's noun (an empty city avenue, no people) full screen with a slow push-back, cream captions on the dark road, the hook bar on top
a quoted author's line: white page, a blue box grows centre-out, the quote reveals word by word in white Inter Tight, the payoff word in cream serif italic, slow drift

a crowd as a field of ink dots (no faces, no gender) popping in a row a frame; on the lonely word one centre dot turns blue and the rest rack soft; on the crowd word the field drifts while the blue dot stays still
a B&W generated still (two coffee cups on a cafe table) full screen, ink captions with a white glow in the window light above the object
the step numeral scales x1.1 -> x5.2 with a 2-28 px blur over the last 6 frames while the words fade, hard cut into the next world (whoosh-cine with it)
self-reference: when the speaker repeats the hook's words, the hook's city still returns and the blue hook bar grows centre-out with those words landing on it one by one
line drawing: a path draws from a small dot to a big blue dot on the 'now' word, four dashed empty circles beside it (nobody saw it), words above
the payoff word alone in big serif italic behind the head (flicker-on), the rest of the clause as a small serif sub-line on the crown, held to the last word; no gradient word

ideas_not_built_yet: a tight hook stack: the three hook lines inside the first 5-6 s (the founding reel's ran 0-12 s because the approved lines sat at 0 / 5.6 / 10.2 s): plan the lines short before recording
the promise as a title bar over the face: an electric-blue box growing centre-out with the serif italic words on it, the head in front (E10, the reference's '3 step breakdown')
a recap row of live mini cards replaying the reel's own hook segments, labelled Hook 1 / 2 / 3 (E19, self-reference)
a flip deck: a portrait card flipping in 3D on successive words, each face one of the speaker's real assets (E28; screenshots they provide)
a name mind map: the speaker's name full width, role words with arrows drawing in a fast stagger (E12, a credibility aside)
a stats card: views and followers counting up live in a ring, a badge icon flying in (E15 full; real numbers only)
a quote box: a blue box with the quote revealing word by word, one word tinted (E25)
a hook diagram: labels over names, connector lines drawing down, the camera close on item 1 then pulling back, depth-of-field on the items not said (E24 full)
a B-roll keyword colour ramp: 6 colour keys a frame, dark blue -> white, on B&W B-roll only, never on the face (E9)
a caption slide-in with horizontal motion blur and a slow drift, direction-matched to the previous exit
translucent glow captions over a warm close-up (E26) and captions tracked to a moving object in a clip (E27)
fine grain (2-3 %) and a soft vignette on every page (the reference has them; the founding reel has none)
cuts snapped to the bed's beat (+-80 ms inside a word gap)
a diegetic prop action on a noun when the speaker records (opening a book on 'breakdown')
size tiers chosen by a tagger (keyword score -> T / M / B, serif about 1 in 6, never two in a row) instead of by hand

sounds the founding reel lacked: a reverse whoosh for the push-out, a short 0.6 s gap riser, paper / print flips (the CC0 pack now has whoosh-reverse, riser-short, paper-flip and paper-riffle; not yet tried here), a boom-bap bed with a clap on 2 and 4
